roles.title: Staff Product Manager - Care Application Platform

bullets: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-native Clinical and Care Tools in the Care App.
Reimagine practitioner workflows using AI for contextual assistance, summarization, intelligent task orchestration, recommendations, documentation, and agent-assisted execution.
Decide what to automate, augment, delegate to an AI agent, or keep human-led based on user value, clinical risk, and operational constraints.
Partner with clinicians, Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Data, Legal, Security, and Compliance to build trustworthy, reusable capabilities across service lines.
Establish evaluation, monitoring, human-oversight, and launch frameworks for AI-enabled experiences, including quality, safety, reliability, adoption, and workflow outcomes.
